fusions.name: Joint Lock
fusions.desc: A precise blow to a joint deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Perfect Enclosure
fusions.desc: Drives bars down in a ring around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, with a 60% chance to leave each enemy [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Skeleton Key
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Walking the Rounds
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and your armour rises by 8%.
